crossRefs.note: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out…
Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land…
He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
to him who struck great kings; for his loving kindness endures forever;
Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children…
Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.
Yahweh our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.
We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We…
Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.

parallels.note: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jahaz
people.line: A town in Moab, site of Israelite victories

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: But Sihon didn’t trust Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
translations.bsb: But Sihon would not trust Israel to pass through his territory. So he gathered all his people, encamped in Jahaz, and fought with Israel.
translations.kjv: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
translations.asv: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
